hypotheses.justification: The remaining statement elaborates without this instance. IsFractionRing.injective A K requires no domain assumption and embeds A into the field K. Thus add `haveI : IsDomain A := Function.Injective.isDomain (algebraMap A K) (IsFractionRing.injective A K)` and retain the original proof. Injectivity into a field also excludes the trivial-ring case.
